item.text:
I refactored the mutable graph internals and the graph cache classes as requested.

For the mutation scaffolding, I added a shared internal helper at [MutableNodeMapConnections.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/G003_guava/guava/src/com/google/common/graph/MutableNodeMapConnections.java:24). `StandardMutableValueGraph` and `StandardMutableNetwork` now use it for “add node if absent” and “get or create node connections” instead of each carrying their own near-identical `addNodeInternal` logic: [StandardMutableValueGraph.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/G003_guava/guava/src/com/google/common/graph/StandardMutableValueGraph.java:60) and [StandardMutableNetwork.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/G003_guava/guava/src/com/google/common/graph/StandardMutableNetwork.java:50). That removes the duplicated node-creation path while keeping the network-specific parallel-edge check ordering intact.

For the cache-management cleanup, I turned `MapIteratorCache` into the owner of the common “check cache, then fall back” control flow via `getIfCachedOrElse(...)` and a `getIfNotCached(...)` hook: [MapIteratorCache.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/G003_guava/guava/src/com/google/common/graph/MapIteratorCache.java:131). `MapRetrievalCache` now only overrides the miss path and its extra two-entry cache behavior, instead of reimplementing the whole lookup flow, and it reuses the shared reference-key match helper too: [MapRetrievalCache.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/G003_guava/guava/src/com/google/common/graph/MapRetrievalCache.java:37). The same refactor is mirrored under `android/guava`.
